# Brevlin KC-60 Compact Wireless Keyboard: User Guide

Version 2.1. This guide describes the Brevlin KC-60, a compact wireless keyboard without a numeric keypad.

## 1. Introduction

The KC-60 is a compact keyboard with a rechargeable battery and a single backlight level. It connects to up to three devices over Bluetooth and switches between them with a key combination. The compact layout saves desk space and suits laptops, tablets and small desks.

## 2. What is in the box

- One KC-60 keyboard
- One USB-C charging cable, 1 m long
- One quick start leaflet

## 3. Connecting the keyboard

Slide the power switch on the side of the keyboard to ON. Press and hold the Fn key together with the letter Q for three seconds, until the indicator blinks quickly. On your device, open the Bluetooth settings, select "Brevlin KC-60" and enter the code shown on the screen.

## 4. Switching between devices

The keyboard stores three devices. Press Fn and then Q to switch to the first device, Fn and then W to switch to the second device, or Fn and then E to switch to the third device. The indicator blinks once when the switch is complete.

If you press a device key for a device that is not stored, the indicator blinks three times and the keyboard stays on the current device.

## 5. Backlight

The KC-60 has one backlight level. Press Fn and Space to turn the backlight on or off. When the backlight is on, it turns off by itself after 30 seconds of inactivity. Any key press turns it on again. The automatic timeout cannot be changed.

## 6. Battery and charging

The KC-60 uses a built-in lithium-polymer battery. With the backlight off, one full charge lasts up to 9 months of typical use. With the backlight on, one full charge lasts up to 6 weeks.

A full charge from empty takes 90 minutes with the USB-C cable connected to a 5 V adapter. The indicator on the top edge glows green when the charge is complete. Charging with a computer USB port takes longer, usually about 2 hours.

The battery indicator blinks orange when less than 10 percent of charge remains. Connect the keyboard to a power source as soon as possible to avoid losing the connection to the device.

## 7. Layout

The compact layout places the arrow keys in an inverted T shape at the bottom right. The function keys share the number row, and you use Fn with the number row to reach F1 to F12. The Fn key is in the bottom left corner, next to the Ctrl key.

## 8. Care

Wipe the keys with a soft, slightly damp cloth. Do not use alcohol-based cleaners on the printed symbols, because they can fade the markings. Remove crumbs from under the keys with compressed air and never with a metal object.

## 9. Troubleshooting

If the keyboard loses its connection, check that the device is within 10 meters and that the keyboard battery is above 10 percent. Remove the old pairing from the device settings and pair the keyboard again. If the keys repeat or respond slowly, update the keyboard firmware through the support page of the Brevlin website.

Warning: Do not expose the keyboard to temperatures above 45 degrees Celsius. Do not open the case, because the battery is built in.
